# Retained notice provenance

`unicode-normalization-mit.txt` is retained unchanged as an earlier dependency
notice. On 2026-09-26, the selected Cargo runtime/build closure, Cargo.lock and own
source imports contained no `unicode-normalization` consumer. Only the notice
manifest and the now-corrected runtime table referenced it. The notice is therefore
